ownerName: Municipal Tourism Office, San Juan, Batangas (LGU)
title: San Juan, Batangas Tourism — Verified Facebook Pages
method: Read the LGU tourism directory page; recorded the exact Facebook link next to the business name (link target taken from page HTML, not the visible text). The page states listed establishments are registered with the LGU.
permittedUse: Link and short factual citation (business name + linked Facebook URL) of a public government page.

title: Acuatico Beach Resort website — home page
method: Opened the business's own website and recorded the Facebook link in its page HTML. Owner-controlled: corroborates the page link only, not the business's registered identity.
permittedUse: Link and short factual citation of the public Facebook link on the website.
